title: oileus minor
intro: Oileus minor, commonly known as Minor Spleenwort or Ophioglossum, is a type of fern species that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties that may help in treating various health conditions such as wounds, infections, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Oileus minor include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiviral activity, making it a promising candidate for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Oileus minor include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
